hrRowZone.INTERVALS: Zone 4–5 · very hard, in short reps

typeHints.EASY: Easy runs are slow enough to chat the whole way. Most of your running should feel like this.
typeHints.TEMPO: A tempo run is steady and hard but controlled: faster than easy, slower than a race. It teaches you to hold a strong pace for longer.
typeHints.INTERVALS: Intervals are short, fast efforts with easy jogging between them. They build speed without wearing you out.
typeHints.LONG: The long run is the longest of your week, at an easy pace. It builds the endurance to go the distance.
typeHints.RACE: Race day: everything in the plan builds to this.
typeHints.WALK: Walking or other low-impact work keeps you moving while your legs recover.
typeHints.OTHER: Cross-training (bike, swim, elliptical) builds fitness without the pounding of running.
